messages:
Ana P.: quick sync — final readiness checklist for EdgeCloud listing + SI integrations. Need owners for: landing hero, joint blog, press embargo window, screenshots, and staging tenant. Target go-live Fri Apr 10. Who can take which? :calendar:

Matt R.: I can do blog + press. Draft to me by Tue EOD. Need partner quote and approved assets. @Priya S. can you share approved messaging?

Priya S.: will share hero copy and 2 CTA variants by tomorrow morning. proposed hero: "Redwood + EdgeCloud: predictable LLM inference across cloud & private deployments". CTAs: `Get started` / `Request demo`. picking tone: product-forward or enterprise?

Liam K.: staging tenant: I can provision. Need partner org id and sample dataset. ETA Wed 09:00 PT. Also flag: screenshots need consistent input prompts — @Ana P., can you drop sample prompts?

Ana P.: sample prompts posted below. also uploading a short checklist: `hero copy, blog draft, partner quote, screenshot script, staging creds, legal signoff`.

Ana P.: ```
# screenshot script (example)
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/api/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_API_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1","prompt":"summarize quarterly results"}'
```

deploy-bot: Staging tenant created: rwd-staging-edgecloud-042 — creds emailed to Liam K. (expires in 72h).

Matt R.: noted. I'll put draft in Google doc and share link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ExampleShare (placeholder).

Priya S.: legal checkpoint — @legal-team needs to sign off by Thu noon. anyone escalate?

Ana P.: I'll ping legal and partner ops. Also planning a 30-min dry run Thu 4:00 PM PT with partners and SI tech lead — calendar invite coming.

Liam K.: 4pm PT works. I'll bring runbook and demo script. :thumbsup:

Matt R.: thanks — holding press embargo until Tue 11:59 PM PT if partner quote lands.

Priya S.: owners recap -> Landing: Priya S.; Blog/Press: Matt R.; Staging & Demos: Liam K.; Legal & Partner Ops: Ana P.

Ana P.: perfect. will share final checklist + calendar invite after legal ack. ping here for any blocker.
